name: mail.search
description: Search authorized messages. Does not change read flags.

name: mail.get
description: Read a message and attachment references without side effects.

name: mail.draft.create
description: Create a local draft; no external delivery.

name: mail.send
description: Simulate send by moving a draft to sent; never sends real email.

name: mail.flags.update
description: Explicitly change a message read flag.

name: mail.move
description: Move received mail among inbox, archive and trash.

name: mail.trash
description: Move a message or draft to trash.

name: mail.attachment.add
description: Attach validated file bytes to a draft.

name: mail.attachment.remove
description: Remove an attachment reference from this record.

name: mail.attachment.get
description: Read an attachment on this record through parent-scoped authorization.
